controllerDefinitionCorrections.definition: Failing to adjust judgment in proportion to the scale, number, or magnitude of what is being discussed.
controllerDefinitionCorrections.frozenCritique: Strongest feature: Donahue responds to Linford’s selection problem with an explicit three-part partition distinguishing naturally sustained physical life, miraculously sustained physical life, and unembodied agents, thereby making his proposed prediction inspectable. Principal limitation: Counting three coarse categories neither proves the partition complete nor warrants assigning one tenth to natural physical realization, because each category can contain differently weighted, finely specified possibilities. Live burden: The affirmative must justify a representation-invariant measure over divine options and show that physical embodiment retains substantial weight when the space is described at comparable granularity. overallBlunderCandidateReviews.rationale: The prior ordering rests on an unsupported analogy, but it is not accepted merely because its conclusion feels believable.

overallBlunderCandidateReviews.label: Scope neglect
overallBlunderCandidateReviews.context: the coherence defense addresses global immodesty and the full disjunction without a weighting rule
overallBlunderCandidateReviews.rationale: Donahue expressly confronts both scale and number, leaving their comparative weights unsupported rather than neglecting their scope.

overallBlunderCandidateReviews.label: Equivocation
overallBlunderCandidateReviews.context: structural symmetry between auxiliary families leaves their numerical weights and predictive differences unresolved
overallBlunderCandidateReviews.rationale: Linford maintains a structural conditional and does not covertly redefine symmetry to mean equal numerical prior probabilities.

overallBlunderCandidateReviews.label: Special pleading
overallBlunderCandidateReviews.context: the same auxiliary replacement rule is applied to both theistic and naturalistic families
overallBlunderCandidateReviews.rationale: The blunder concerns unresolved numerical asymmetry, while Linford grants neither worldview an unprincipled exception from the common rule.

overallBlunderCandidateReviews.label: Ambiguity effect
overallBlunderCandidateReviews.context: supernatural agency receives a larger prior penalty because physical ontology is familiar
overallBlunderCandidateReviews.rationale: The comparative penalty explicitly privileges familiar physical possibilities over uncertain unfamiliar agency without an independent evidential weighting principle.

acceptedTags.label: Ambiguity effect
acceptedTags.context: physical hypotheses are more familiar while supernatural agency is radically unlike observed entities
acceptedTags.rationale: Linford explicitly imposes the larger prior penalty because supernatural agency is unfamiliar, matching the defined preference for familiar over uncertain options.

baselineComparison.interpretation: All thirty-two moves and four overall blunders were reviewed against all thirteen local definitions by both isolated reviewers, with fresh anonymous decisions on all thirty-five union candidates. The low retained tag count reflects the qualified, technically substantive exchange and exact-definition exclusions, not a target rate or exemption: missing measures, disputed analogies, and unsupported magnitudes remain fully criticized even when no catalog label fits. No side balance was imposed.
